text:
kevin: FYI - hit flaky 429s in sampleapp pagination e2e today. failing intermittently on page 3-4. repro with load harness.

kevin: harness: `wrk -t8 -c200 -d30s \"http://staging.sampleapp.local/search?q=test\"`

kevin: logs show many concurrent requests for subsequent pages: client issues page 2 before page 1 body processed. server rate headers: x-rw-rate-limit=20, x-rw-rate-remaining=1, x-rw-quota-reset=3s.

lina: which SDK is sampleapp using?

kevin: Go SDK v0.9.2 that has prefetcher enabled (Prefetch=2) for pagination. JS SDK used to be 0 prefetch, so different behavior.

sam: ah that explains parity gap. JS iterates pages lazily, Go prefetcher races ahead and increases in-flight tokens. We saw similar in customer bug last month.

anna: we intended prefetch to improve latency but forgot to tie it to the per-account concurrency governor. Oops.

kevin: quick mitigation: set PREFETCH_PAGES=0 in sampleapp env -> no more 429s in short run.

lina: can we auto-disable prefetch when rate headers show low remaining? i.e., if x-rw-rate-remaining < prefetch => reduce.

sam: yes, implement adaptive prefetch: on response read rate headers and cap outstanding page fetches to min(conf.Prefetch, x-rw-rate-remaining).

anna: adding to SDK parity board as GH #1199. Plan: implement header-aware prefetch cap + opt-in toggles.

kevin: also noticed auth retry behavior: when 401 happens we spawn token refresh and retry; if multiple page requests see 401 simultaneously this causes N refresh attempts. JS dedups refresh; Go doesn't. Another parity item.

lina: filed #1200 for token-refresh singleflight in Go SDK. I'll take it. ETA tomorrow.

sam: proposal for short-term sampleapp doc change: add quickstart note recommending PREFETCH_PAGES=0 for onboarding scripts and CI harnesses that do bursty paging.

kevin: sampleapp PR ready -> 2481. It documents env flags + shows snippet: 

```yaml
env:
  PREFETCH_PAGES: "0"
  RW_MAX_CONCURRENCY: "16"
```

sam: sdk-bot: `go test ./sdk -run TestPaginationAdaptive -v` -> PASS (12ms) :white_check_mark:

qa-ci: ran 10k-search soak with PREFETCH_PAGES=1 + adaptive prefetch patch in staging - no 429s after 45m.

anna: ok next steps: 1) implement adaptive prefetch in Go SDK (#1199), 2) singleflight token refresh (#1200), 3) bump sampleapp quickstart to recommend PREFETCH_PAGES=0 for heavy burst onboarding, 4) add e2e test that simulates header-driven backpressure.

kevin: thanks all. This should reduce onboarding friction and improve parity. moving card to in-progress. :shipit:
